QuestInfo.name: [Advice from Dr. Pepper] Intellectual Poise
QuestInfo.0: You'll need to win the trust of the people to pass the M-Forcer Action Exam! Talk to Dr. Pepper to learn how to leave a good impression on others. She's the expert, after all.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Pepper says you'll need Intellectual Poise. Defeat monsters to get self-help books to learn all about it. You'll need to hunt monsters #bbetween 11 levels below you and 21 levels above you#k to find the self-help books.\n\n #rTip: This quest is repeatable if you lose your Intellectual Poise.
QuestInfo.2: You're received Intellectual Poise from Dr. Pepper!

0.0: If you want to be an M-Forcer, you have to win the trust of the people, right? And people trust those who have a calm, intellectual air, like me... hiccup!
0.1: But I'm only halfway done gulping down, I mean, fine-tuning my latest batch of potions, so you'll have to read a self-help book. Browsing through 10 copies of #bA Better You: Copying the Politicians#k should help you learn all about Intellectual Poise.

yes.0: You can get the self-help book by hunting monsters. Just don't bother with any that are #bover 21 levels above you.#k They're 'too good' to need to improve themselves.

no.0: I see how it is. Think you're better than the rest of us? NO POTIONS FOR YOU... hiccup!

1.0: Did you read the books? Sorry if I'm not paying attention. I had to make up a whole new batch of potions because I drank all of my last batch... hiccup!
